recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is; no core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-6208 unless a future Patient Care decision intentionally changes Flag.author target profiles.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive Patient Care change request to extend Flag.author so an alert/flag can be authored by an Organization as well as Practitioner, Device, or Patient.
initial_application: Historical commit c112ec2e11af515a5d2e6b1806fa6350e188d22b explicitly applied #6208 by changing the Flag.author type in the then-authoritative Flag spreadsheet to Reference(Device | Organization | Patient | Practitioner) and updating the definition to mention organization.
additional_context: The current Flag resource is active in source/fhir.ini. Later source refactors moved Flag from spreadsheet source to source/flag/structuredefinition-Flag.xml, where Organization remains in the Flag.author targetProfile list. Later Flag.author changes added RelatedPerson and PractitionerRole without reversing Organization support. FHIR-6171 supplied the public-health/Ebola Flag use case background but concerned Flag.patient/subject rather than Flag.author. Exact Zulip and Confluence searches for FHIR-6208 found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit with no source change because source/flag/structuredefinition-Flag.xml already defines Flag.author as a Reference that includes Organization.

related_jiras.note: The FHIR-6208 description references the same public-health Flag use case, but FHIR-6171 changes Flag.patient/subject rather than Flag.author and was not decided here.
A later Flag.author change added RelatedPerson and PractitionerRole while preserving Organization, confirming no reversal of FHIR-6208.
